predictor_rule: Select the mandatory R0 (M00/xgboost/onset) if its original native selection scores are verified, out of time after training/calibration, contain both classes and have exact paired evaluation keys/labels for both horizons. Otherwise BLOCKED. No performance ranking of Beta01/02 or evaluation-based substitution.
roles: Use each frozen R0 cell's original train/calibration/selection/evaluation roles with its original global origin embargo. Selection targets July-December of Y-1; evaluation Y. No new fits; calibration rows are excluded from policy selection and hard-negative diagnostics.

policy.formal_adoption: Mauricio explicitly ratified both criteria for EXP-BETA03 before implementation; reaffirmed in the integral closure request
policy.exposure: Exact scored eligible municipality-target-months divided by 12, identical to Beta01/02. Re-score frozen R0 alerts on this same denominator. Preserve its historical broader monitored-exposure selection cap separately; do not silently claim identical policy semantics.
policy.global: Reuse exp_beta01.thresholds: maximize detected onsets under floor(exposure*budget); whole score ties, fewer false positives then higher threshold; null means no alerts. Freeze independently on each original selection role, never evaluation.

department.rule: Evaluate one regularized department policy only when both departments meet support and the development global-policy false-alert-rate gap is at least 0.5 per eligible municipality-year. Reuse the same constrained selector locally; weight local threshold by n/(n+24), shrink toward global, then take max(local feasible threshold, blend) to retain the local development cap. A null local threshold remains no alerts; insufficient support returns global. No evaluation-based arm selection.

fp_aware.rule: Diagnose high-confidence false positives and repeated municipal errors only in the original selection role. Learning intervention requires reproducible errors across at least two disjoint out-of-time blocks from the same frozen predictor, plus an untouched development block for policy selection. Original artifacts provide only one six-month selection block per fitted predictor; calibration scores were fitted by its calibrator and evaluation is forbidden for mining. Without that independent support, record CONDICIONAL_NO_JUSTIFICADO; do not construct new OOF fits or reuse evaluation to manufacture support.

comparison: Exact R0 origin/target/municipality/truth/score pairing; preserve reference alerts and compare GLOBAL and conditionally DEPARTMENT. Same direct H5 onset T1/T2, never NB2 marginal T2. Metrics all/year/department/horizon, sensitivity difference against R0, budget and descriptive margin jointly; no retuning after results.
confirmation: 2020-2022 reused retrospective development; 2024 consumed retrospective stress, excluded from every selection role; no 2025 or independent confirmation.
